title: NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own) — Contents Amounts Already Sworn on the Claim
content:
Claim file practice on the NFIP General Property Form and RCBAP Flood Policies (Write Your Own): the contents amount already sworn on a claim, set against a further contents proof of loss on that claim.

**Rule.** The contents amount already sworn on the claim is worked out as follows: when the claim carries contents proofs of loss and the latest of them was received no later than the proof-of-loss period after the date of loss, counted by adding the days to the date of loss on the calendar, the amounts sworn on them are added together; when the claim carries no contents proof of loss whose latest was received within that period but contents payments were issued on the claim on the adjuster's report signed in lieu of a proof of loss, the contents payment items voided on the claim are subtracted from the contents payments issued on it; otherwise nothing is already sworn on the claim.

The proof-of-loss period is 60 calendar days after the date of loss, a receipt on the last day being within it.

## Ladder

| Claim file | Already sworn |
|---|---|
| Contents proofs of loss, latest received by day 60 | the total sworn on them |
| No contents proof of loss whose latest is within day 60; contents payments issued on the adjuster's report signed in lieu | contents payments less voided items |
| Neither | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical; date of loss 20 September)

- Contents proofs of loss of 9,000.00 and 3,000.00, latest received 19 November (day 60): 12,000.00.
- One contents proof of loss received 20 November (day 61); contents payments of 7,500.00 issued, none voided: 7,500.00.
